phase.scope: Internal finite algebra only. Circuit-to-phase and circuit-to-response extraction remain supplied evidence. Phase-axis noise excludes other Pauli components, synthesis, Clifford corrections, preparations, measurements and idles.

syndrome_subspaces.construction: Unique RREF bases; distinct spans checked exhaustively; independent Gaussian-binomial crosscheck.
syndrome_subspaces.scope: This is an exhaustive family of linear subspaces of six syndrome bits, not a proof that each corresponding quantum measurement is useful or cheaply realizable.
